---
name: Propose a factor
about: Something the catalogue should hold and does not.
labels: catalogue
---

An entry needs a definition that can be stated from published work. A rule that
has to be invented does not go in under a borrowed name, because the absence of
an entry is visible and a wrong one is not.

**Name**

<!-- for example: Keltner Channel -->

**The definition**

<!--
The formula, and the source it comes from. If several sources disagree, say so
and say which one you would follow. That disagreement is usually the most
useful part of the entry.
-->

**Kind**

<!-- Delete the three that do not apply. -->

- indicator, a number per bar from price and volume
- signal, a boolean per bar from price and volume
- fundamental, a number per reporting period from the accounts
- composite, a rank or score across a universe

**What it consumes**

<!--
Fields from catalog/inputs.yaml, plus a benchmark or market series if it needs
one. If it needs a field the vocabulary does not have, say which.
-->

**Where implementations of this disagree**

<!--
Smoothing constant, sample against population deviation, which bar the window
starts on, what happens on a tie. Optional, and the part most worth writing.
-->
